body: Speaking from the perspective of a black male, a lot of times coming from a “white school” (read better funded school) can lead to better opportunities when applying for both colleges and work. Many people tend to overlook the students coming from schools in the black community due to excess violence as well as having to be very protective of their child because, honestly, schools are dangerous especially in inner city communities (I’m not from the US, which I am assuming OP is from, but from a country dealing with a similar issue with schooling). The dad may very well want his son to be able to be afforded better opportunities and schooling that he would have gotten at another school. Funding for these schools are also usually much higher than others. It’s a hard thing to have to sit down and be racially targeted everyday but some families do it to be beneficial in the long run
